integrity: The exact source generator is rebuilt over \(\mathbb F_3\); all \(81\) codewords are enumerated; the published weight enumerator and \(15\) minimal access sets are reproduced before symmetry calculations. All \(8!\) code-coordinate permutations and \(7!\) participant permutations are exhausted, and the final verifier replays these checks without sampling.
scientific_limitations: Exact for the source's explicit ternary [8,4,4] cyclic code, coordinate-permutation automorphisms, and dealer coordinate 0. Monomial automorphisms and other family members are not classified.
title: Semidihedral code symmetry and non-liftable access-policy symmetries in a ternary cyclic example
